title: eligibility.participation_rights_derived event payload (v1)
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 19d.14 (canon-0.6.0, PACK-07, ADR-026). Produced by epd2_eligibility_service.events.build_participation_rights_derived_event. Marks that a participant-side capability derivation happened for exactly one (subject_reference, process_id, action_code) tuple - never the full, non-persisted ParticipationRightsProfile (canon 19d.1/19d.14). Carries only the four already-public claim booleans, never any identity or membership fact that produced them.
